status: Complete local built-in Text Roll node; not published; APP_VERSION stays 2.203

reference.author: daniel_maarleveld / Studio Daniel Maarleveld
reference.inspection: Read-only inspection of all three user-opened carousel videos. Thick scrolling letters wrapped around a circle with many contour layers and 3D distortion. Original independent implementation, no reference code/media copied. Reference returned to its first slide.

features: Standalone generator, editable uppercase SFONT text with real thick Round/Block glyph unions, closed contours and triangulated counters
Drum or Ring; radial/axial depth, contour slices, arc, repeats, tracking, height/radius, wave/lobes and twist
Scroll, Rock and Tumble; Manual or Timeline, reversible integer loops and exact endpoints; random access without accumulated state
Two-sided solid letter face and side-wall depth buffer; no opaque background cylinder; Hidden lines off retains rear contours
Invariant camera envelope including accents; stable framing, orthographic/perspective and view angle/elevation/roll
Ordinary bounded XY paths and pen indices for existing SVG/G-code/receipt exports; no machine Z from visual depth
64 normalized characters / four repeats; bounded glyph cache/work, uniform density/resolution reduction or whole refusal at 120k points
Four live 72 x 100 mm Help examples and self-contained portable projects

validation.lint: passed for baked node, examples and both tools without warnings/errors
validation.catalog: passed; 366 source modules, 368 registry entries, 233 generators
focusedCoverage: Every shared SFONT glyph in both fonts and three weights; O counter is physically empty
All six surface/movement pairs, finite bounded ink, exact loop endpoints, Manual freeze and random-access parity
Live controls, unsupported visible fallback, accents, excessive text/invalid values and extreme canvas/work budgets
Independent solid-face occlusion and open-counter tests, perspective geometry, invariant framing and portable Help parity
Actual SVG and both servo/bed-Z export functions retain every path and drawing move
